correctness.rationale: For an occupied original subset A, exactly I(A)=Σ_{v∈A}d_v−e(A) midpoint sites are blocked. Summing over the other sites factors the original marginal into the stated Bernoulli law Q tilted by F=(1+c/n)^e(A). For K=|A|, 0≤F−1≤(c/2n)K(K−1)e^(cK/2). Expanding ordered pairs under Q, their weights contribute at most c²e^c, and the remaining independent mgfs at most exp[c(e^(c/2)−1)], giving exactly the displayed constant. Since EF≥1, normalization costs at most E(F−1) in total variation; F≤e^(cK/2) also bounds all fixed moments of K under the actual law uniformly. Uniform nq_v=c exp(−c d_v/n)+O_c(1/n) and Σq_v²=O_c(1/n) give the marked Poisson Laplace functional and the normalized partition limit by logarithms. Independently verify joint convergence by drawing a Bernoulli(p_n) array on all m_n midpoint sites independently of A and then deleting the blocked successes to produce Y_n. The deletion count has expectation at most np_n E K=O_c(1); the normalization is asymptotic to √(βcn), so the difference is negligible while the independent full array has the binomial CLT. The exact conditional mean mp_n−p_n I(A) gives the raw covariance: the internal-edge term tends to zero by uniform third moments; the other term uses uniform integrability of products of Poisson mark integrals (bounded by K²) and np_n→c. The Poisson covariance is ∫t c e^(−ct) μ(dt), giving the stated negative limit. With μ=δ_ρ, differentiating c e^(−ρc) verifies the unique maximum at 1/ρ of the limiting mean, not a finite-size extremum claim.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics do not prove distribution limits. Limits are at fixed c, and the claimed normal scaling uses β>0; the graph-uniform finite TV inequality has no density assumption. No uniform-in-c asymptotic optimization is implied.

value.rationale: The model separates rare original-site occupancy from bulk midpoint occupancy without requiring graph symmetry. The marked law captures degree heterogeneity, and the nonzero raw covariance shows what disappears under Gaussian-scale independence. These are natural equilibrium observables; the explicit uniform bound and partition correction make the mechanism quantitative without implying a phase transition.
residual_risks: No value claim rests on dynamics, zero-density Gaussian limits, or uniform control for growing c.
